question: I was thinking back to our previous conversation about the Radiation Amplified zombie, and I was wondering if you remembered what we finally decided to name it?

gold_sessions.user_turns:
[turn 1] Hmm, not sure about a name referencing other games. Any other name ideas?

[turn 3] Contaminated Colossus is a good one! How about a few one-word names that might flow off the tongue a little better?

[turn 5] Fissionator is a REALLY cool one, especially if it's given a more clunky, mechanical-looking design. Perhaps it's made to look like the host was infected while working in a radiated environment and thus had protective clothing on? This could make the name sounding machine-like make a little more sense

[turn 7] Those sound like great ideas! How about mine?

The Fissionator could have an area-of-effect attack; the closer you get to it the more damage you take over time. This would also give an extra purpose to the vision-distortion it causes; not only is it a hindrance to the player, it's also a warning to not get any closer without risking your life. Perhaps the AoE damage would be nullified by Cosmic Cleanse, bht the vision effect would only be partially negated, leaving some of the challenge present if you get too close.

As for the Fissionator's attacks, I like the idea of them causing radiation poisoning! Maybe to add to this, the Fissionators death causes a radioactive burst that turns zombies into radioactive ones, upping their damage and making them, too, give the radiation effect when they attack the player. To signal this, maybe they could get a light green glow and you could see the slime-parasite within the host body reacting violently to the sudden radiation exposure

[turn 9] Can you give me some ideas for what you think the Fissionator could look like? I imagine it to be a slower, lumbering threat that causes stress less from being directly deadly, but rather from the passive radiation it emits and its ability to transform zombies on death

[turn 11] Let's try keeping the green-ooze parasite and human host theme as much as possible, please. Feel free to go all out with body horror and describing potential deformations from the parasite and radiation!

[turn 13] Those all sound terrifying and wonderful! I think it would also be creepy if the slime-parasite could be see writhing and probing violently out of a large gash in the Fissionators neck, as if looking for a new host to escape the uncontrolled radiation. This would also be a cool way to show its attack against the player; the parasite is trying to worm its way into the player's mouth, slowing player movement as it tries to break free from this radioactive prison

[turn 15] I love the idea of the protective suit being melted into the Fissionators host! It adds to the horror of the design, and also gives a reason as tk why the parasite hasn't just left to seek a new host on its own; the suit melded to the flesh has trapped it inside the host
